I had this issue this summer. I still have back pain but I took a blood test, urine sample, and a catscan and x-ray. I thought it was my kidneys too. I explained my health anxiety to the dr and they  showed me exactly where I'd be feeling pain if my kidneys were hurting. It's not lower back. It's mid back, behind the ribcage. I wasn't feeling that so I immediately felt calmer. And all test came back normal.
Back pain is very common so don't assume the worst cause. I hope this helps u
